## Magic move example

::: magic-move

```r
Year.Release <- game$Year.Release
counts <- data.frame(table(Year.Release))
```

```r
Year.Release <- game$Year.Release
counts <- data.frame(
  table(Year.Release)
)
p <- game %>%
  select(Year.Release, Global.Sales)
```

```r
Year.Release <- game$Year.Release
counts <- data.frame(
  table(Year.Release)
)
p <- game %>%
  select(Year.Release, Global.Sales) %>%
  group_by(Year.Release) %>%
  summarise(Total.Sales = sum(Global.Sales))
```

:::

## Another example

::: magic-move

```javascript
if (condition) a else b
```

```javascript
if (condition) {
  a
} else {
  b
}
```

:::
